title: Full-stack developer internship (React + Node)
description: Corda Bits is a 40-person software house in Hasselt that builds customer portals and internal tooling for Belgian SMEs. You join a product squad of six as a junior full-stack developer and ship real user stories from sprint one. A senior engineer mentors you twice a week and code review is never skipped.
responsibilities: Build React/Next.js screens from Figma designs
Write and document REST endpoints in Node.js
Add tests and fix bugs reported by the support team
Join daily stand-ups and sprint reviews with the client
requirements: Bachelor ICT (or equivalent) with at least one real TypeScript project
Comfortable with Git and pull requests

title: Data analyst internship - production reporting
description: Flanders Steel Group runs three production lines in Genk. Our supply-chain analytics cell needs an intern who can turn raw machine log exports into monthly KPI dashboards for plant managers. You work with twenty years of production data and learn how a large corporate governs its numbers.
responsibilities: Model production data in SQL and Power BI
Automate a weekly Excel report with Python
Interview plant managers to define KPI definitions
Present findings to the operations board
requirements: Master in business engineering, statistics or computer science
Able to explain numbers to non-technical stakeholders

title: Research internship - applied machine learning for sensor data
description: Join the sensor analytics group to build and benchmark time-series models on industrial vibration data collected with regional partners. The goal is a reproducible benchmark study and, if results hold, a co-authored workshop paper. A master thesis can be built on the same dataset.
responsibilities: Clean and document a 40 GB sensor dataset
Implement three baseline models and one proposed model
Run ablations and record them in a reproducible pipeline
Write a 10-page technical report in English
requirements: Master student in computer science, engineering or physics
Confident Python and basic scikit-learn or PyTorch
Able to work independently on an open problem

title: Embedded / IoT engineering internship
description: Velden Automation builds retrofit sensor kits that make older production machines report their status. You prototype a sensor gateway, wire it into the shop floor network and write both the firmware and a thin MQTT ingestion service.
responsibilities: Program an ESP32-based gateway in C
Set up MQTT ingestion and a small Docker test rig
Document wiring diagrams and commissioning steps
Test the kit on two partner machines
requirements: Coursework or hobby experience with microcontrollers
Not afraid of a production environment

title: Front-end intern for a B2B dashboard (remote)
description: Kompas Health is an eight-person startup making scheduling software for physiotherapy practices. You take ownership of the component library: translate Figma tokens into a documented React component set and fix the accessibility issues our first customers keep reporting.
responsibilities: Turn Figma components into typed React components
Improve keyboard navigation and contrast on core screens
Write short usage notes per component
Ship small features alongside the CTO
requirements: Can work independently in a remote, async team

title: UX/UI design internship for public sector apps
description: Studio Peer is a twelve-person digital agency that redesigns municipal services. You run usability sessions with citizens, turn the findings into wireframes and hand a polished Figma file to the developers. Expect a lot of iteration based on real user feedback.
responsibilities: Recruit and moderate five usability sessions
Produce wireframes and a clickable prototype in Figma
Write accessibility notes per screen (WCAG AA)
Present the design rationale to the client
requirements: Bachelor in communication, design or multimedia
Figma portfolio with at least one end-to-end case

title: Digital services internship - city of Hasselt
description: The digital services team is rolling out an online appointment system across twelve city desks. As an intern you map the current paper processes, document requirements and support the rollout with training material and impact measurements.
responsibilities: Map and document six current desk processes
Write user stories and acceptance criteria
Measure waiting times before and after rollout
Train desk staff on the new tool
requirements: Bachelor in business administration, ICT or public management
Able to work with a broad range of colleagues

title: Impact measurement internship (energy poverty)
description: Klimaat Limburg coordinates volunteers who help families in energy poverty with small home fixations. You build the impact framework: define indicators, collect data from volunteers and turn it into a report for our funders.
responsibilities: Define impact indicators with the programme lead
Set up a simple data collection form for volunteers
Analyse three years of intervention records
Write the annual impact report
requirements: Studying in social sciences, economics or environmental studies
Feels at home in a small, informal team

title: Back-end internship (.NET + Azure)
description: Maas IT Services maintains the claims platform of a large insurer. The team is moving twenty legacy services to Azure. You build a migration pattern for two of them, write the tests and document the rollout so the remaining services can follow it.
responsibilities: Rewrite two legacy services on .NET with Azure Functions
Write integration tests against a containerised SQL database
Set up a CI/CD pipeline stage for the new services
Document the migration pattern in the internal wiki
requirements: Bachelor or master in computer science
C# and SQL coursework or internship experience
English is the working language, Dutch is a plus

title: Marketing analytics internship
description: Archive listing kept for demonstration: the autumn campaign analytics internship for Atlas Retail, already filled. Kept visible so you can filter on status and archive it if you like.
responsibilities: Build a campaign performance dashboard
Report weekly on channel performance
Support A/B test analysis
